integrity: The proof reconstructs each neighbourhood by singleton instance arguments and proves sharpness with two explicit n-world frames that differ only on the full carrier. The 2026 primary full text was inspected at the BAIO definition, the set-indexed frame operator, Lemma 3.5, and the duality reconstruction step. Candidate-specific published-finding and literature searches did not locate the sharp finite cutoff. A 2022 paper on arity-indexed INL fragments is recorded as a residual comparison risk because its full text was unavailable.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for arbitrary labelled finite instantial neighbourhood frames and gives a worst-case instance-arity cutoff. Restricted frame classes may admit smaller cutoffs. It concerns exact frame reconstruction from algebraic operations, not a general formula-size or modal-depth normal form.
title: Sharp finite instance-arity cutoff for instantial neighbourhood frames
